主要内容: On March 8, 2016, Medallion Financial Corp announced that its unconsolidated wholly-owned portfolio company, Medallion Bank, received an investment grade rating of A+ from Egan-Jones Ratings Co. The rating reaffirms the Bank’s strong credit position. Medallion Bank has been profitable in every full year since its inception over 12 years ago, with 2015 being one of its most profitable years. The Bank’s consumer lending businesses contributed 80% of the Company’s earnings in 2015, and the Company anticipates continued growth in this area.
